title: Issue with TBR displaying on the graph
body:
When using Omnipod Dash in master branch or Accu check Combo with the new combo driver in the APPS dev branch 3.1.0.3, TBR is displayed incorrectly in Xdrip (last nightly version).
AAPS sends TBR with local broadcast to Xdrip and those are displayed with multiple vertical lines.
However if Accu check combo is used with ruffy, everything is displayed correctly.
Unfortunately I don't know if it's due to AAPS or Xdrip.
